items.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And the kid's mother that I went to school with, Mrs. Eubanks, was their sister. Was the Hawkins brother's sister. [INTERVIEWEE] She sold tickets at the movie.

ctx.x: And Lowe was walked in the door, stooped over all that money. He was very young. Jelly was very young. My brother was very young.
Lowe was very young. They owned a saloon. And on the other side was the Nickelodeon. And the kid's mother that I went to school with, Mrs. Eubanks, was their sister. Was the Hawkins brother's sister.
She sold tickets at the movie. And they just gave Jelly this. And they just gave Jelly this.
